name: hunarbee-be
description: Hunarbee microservices monorepo — single node_modules, API gateway

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n gateway,auth,programs,payments -c yellow,cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @hunarbee/gateway" "npm run dev -w @hunarbee/auth-service" "npm run dev -w @hunarbee/programs-service" "npm run dev -w @hunarbee/payments-service"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hunarbee/shared && npm run build -w @hunarbee/auth-service && npm run build -w @hunarbee/programs-service && npm run build -w @hunarbee/payments-service && npm run build -w @hunarbee/gateway
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n gateway,auth,programs,payments -c yellow,cyan,magenta,green "npm run start -w @hunarbee/gateway" "npm run start -w @hunarbee/auth-service" "npm run start -w @hunarbee/programs-service" "npm run start -w @hunarbee/payments-service"
